notes.title: Update v1.0.0
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added 4 new characters in addition to the classic character
[*] Added 3 new biomes that generate throughout the world (Junkyard, Crystal, and Ice)
[*] The module you get when mining scrap now depends on what biome you are in
[*] Entering a portal in the Core Digital Conscious Vault with Eternity sends you to a challenge moon
[*] Added "The Tower" which generates [spoiler]on the surface and to the left past The Great Barrier[/spoiler]
[*] Added "The Crypt" which generates in the sky at [spoiler]X=0 Y=-1500[/spoiler]
[*] Added "H-10" enemy
[*] When mining scrap, there is a 5% chance H-10 will spawn from it instead of getting a module
[*] Added "Turret" enemy
[*] Added 6 Dungeon structures that have turrets and/or parkour that rewards you with scrap at the end
[*] Added much fancier caves to world generation
[*] Stalactites 8 or less blocks over you will now fall dealing 5 damage if they hit you
[*] Magma now glows
[*] Added "Laser Light" Upgrade
[*] Added "Ore Visibility" Upgrade
[*] Added "Dash Velocity" Upgrade
[*] Added "Insta Bombs" Upgrade
[*] Added "Precision Targeting" Upgrade
[*] Added "Energy" Upgrade
[*] Added "Energy 2" Upgrade
[*] Added "Dash" Module
[*] Added "Grappling Hook" Module
[*] Added "Heat Resistance" Module
[*] Added "Light Burst" Module
[*] Added "Wall Climb" Module
[*] Added "Salvage" Module
[*] Added "Battery" Module
[*] Added "Shatter" Module
[*] Added "Radiance" Module
[*] Added "Vein Miner" Module
[*] New Achievement "Recall"
[*] New Achievement "New Horizons"
[*] New Achievement "Zenith"
[*] Added an inventory preview to crafting menu
[*] Added your % chance to critical hit to the stats HUD
[*] Small text will appear reading "Crit!" when getting a critical hit
[*] Added a new setting for if to show critical hits or not
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed The Sky Digital Conscious Vault
[*] Removed "Polarity" Achievement
[*] Flight has been changed from a Module to an Upgrade
[*] Magma now deals 40% of your max fuel as damage per second instead of 20%
[*] You can no longer explode and destroy magma
[*] You no longer need to be standing on ground to deploy torches
[*] The ghost from teleporting is now prettier looking
[*] You can now zoom the camera out twice as far
[*] You can now quickly open the crafting menu by pressing "C" by default
[*] Bombs now emit fuse particles
[*] Bombs breaking blocks now emit block breaking particles
[*] Removed "Damage" Module
[*] Removed "Speed" Module
[*] Removed "Night Vision" Upgrade
[*] Renamed "Bullet Damage" to "Laser Damage"
[*] Renamed "Bullet Damage 2" to "Laser Damage 2"
[*] Renamed "Bullet Speed" to "Laser Speed"
[*] Updated sprite for "Familiar" Module
[*] Updated sprite for "Fuel Reserve" Item
[*] Updated the scrolling background on the title screen
[*] Scrap no longer generates at x666 y666
[*] Added a tooltip to the pin button in the upgrades menu
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed not being able to close the inventory with just the HUD
[*] Fixed the light engine getting wonky at far distances
[*] Fixed many floating point errors when going far
[*] Fixed structures' positions not being random
[*] Fixed the game sometimes breaking when continuing a run after reopening the game
[/list]
[h2]Technical Stuff[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated to Godot 4.3
[*] Structures have been internally reworked
[*] Changed the hitbox shape of P-10's laser to be a pill
[*] The inventory has been internally reworked
[*] "Fully Optimized" Achievement is now detected automatically
[*] Renamed "Module Shrine" to "Module Altar"
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.0 Release Date
notes.content:
[h3]The game's full release will be coming this next Monday, on the 16th![/h3]

[h3]Some things to look forward to:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Brand new characters
[*]Biomes
[*]Module rework
[*]New structures
[*]Something new to explore...
[*]And MUCH more!
[/list]
Thank you all for patiently waiting!

notes.title: Patch v0.6.1
notes.content: - Fixed lighting not working

notes.title: Update v0.6.0
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2]
- Added new item "Fuel Reserve"
-- Will be consumed when shooting a block and will not use up any fuel
- Added new upgrade "Bomb Radius"
- Added new Module "Familiar"
-- Gives you a small friend that follows you and shoots blocks along with you
- Buffed Damage Module's damage from 0.1 to 0.25
- Great Barriers now have shrines on top of them that teleport you to spawn

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed fire rate being saved to a new run when pressing continue after winning
- Fixed "Deploy Torch" button rendering in front of the death text
- Fixed Idle detection being slightly wrong

[h2]Technical Stuff[/h2]
- All of the games scenes are now in their own folder
- Removed old/unused code
- Bombs now use png's to determine what blocks to explode
- Shrunk the size of the input buttons in the controls menu
- Great Barriers are now 1 block thicker
- Blocks generated at spawn are now technically a structure

notes.title: Update v0.4.0
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2]
- Updated block breaking textures
- Added a sound effect when placing a block
- Landing on the ground creates a cloud of dust
- Lasers now have a trail of particles when shot
- Teleport Bolt creates a ghost image of P-10 at where they were before teleporting
- P-10 now emits particles when flying
- Added Pebbles, Stalagmites, and Stalactites to world generation
- P-10's lasers now have a very slight deviation in the angle they shoot at

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed back buttons in certain menus not working
- Fixed sometimes not being able to shoot
- Fixed controller input being janky in the settings menu
- Fixed clicking out of window not pausing the game
- Fixed pressing R causing the game to keep restarting indefinitely

notes.title: Oddment out in Early Access
notes.content:
After a couple years of thinking about, 5 months of development and a lot of excitement and anxiety:

[h2]Oddment is now out on Steam! (In early access)[/h2]
Thank you to all my friends who have contributed their time and effort to this project and helped it come to fruition, I could not of made this game without them.

Thank you to everyone who wishlisted and followed the game!
